reviews.name: Dolce Bocca
reviews.text:
It’s wonderful that Turkish mosques are always open and welcoming. The prayer area is very clean, and there are also toilets and proper facilities for wudu (ablution). There’s even a place where you can get tea or coffee, which is such a nice touch.

It can be really disappointing to travel a long way to other mosques only to find them closed. Turkish mosques, however, never seem to disappoint. It’s always lovely to find the doors open and be welcomed by friendly, smiling people. It truly makes you feel welcome and comfortable. Thank you for providing such a warm and welcoming place.

reviews.name: Nayla H
reviews.text:
House of Allah 🌟
Large prayer area for men and women. One entrance for both but women section is upstairs. Wudu facilities for women is also upstairs before you enter the prayer room.

Clean carpet, comfortable when quiet, clear recitation of the imam, unlike most Turkish the imam (maghrib sep 3, 2026) was not reciting fast.

Parking available around the masjid.

May Allah swt accept all our prayers & du’a 🤍

reviews.name: Sarah Wahid
reviews.text: Neben dem bereits geschilderten Vorfall wurde die betroffene junge Frau Herkunft innerhalb der Moschee nicht nur respektlos behandelt und ausgeschlossen, sondern es wurden ihr gegenüber auch beleidigende und unangemessene Ausdrücke verwendet. Dieses Verhalten ist in keiner Weise akzeptabel und widerspricht grundlegend den Werten eines religiösen Ortes. Una moschea dovrebbe essere un luogo di pace, rispetto e dignità. L’uso di insulti e la denigrazione di una persona rappresentano una chiara violazione di questi principi fondamentali.
reviews.textTranslated: In addition to the incident already described, the young woman was not only treated disrespectfully and excluded within the mosque, but was also subjected to insulting and inappropriate language. This behavior is in no way acceptable and fundamentally contradicts the values ​​of a place of worship. A mosque should be a place of peace, respect, and dignity. The use of insults and the denigration of a person represent a clear violation of these fundamental principles.
